blockbuilder.visual_critic_note: Consistent dark-theme dashboard with intentional panel structure and uppercase labels, but the color-usage scatter plot is nearly unreadable (dots too small, insufficient contrast) and the force-directed graph has heavily overlapping labels, preventing reliable data extraction from two of the three main panels.
blockbuilder.encoding_integrity_note: Honest throughout: bar chart has zero baseline, both node-size and dot-size scales use scaleSqrt, timeline and network domains are data-driven via d3.extent/d3.max, and the hardcoded hue [0,360]/lightness [0,100] axes are semantically correct; minor robustness gap from keyless bar-join on filter updates.
flags: Stale Scale (brush x/y scales captured in closure at creation, no ResizeObserver — stale after window resize)
blockbuilder.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag coalescing is correctly implemented and there are no cross-view feedback loops, but brush scale closures lack a ResizeObserver so pixel-to-data mapping goes stale if the viewport is resized.
blockbuilder.cognitive_load_note: 4-panel linked dashboard is structurally manageable and the dark layout groups views coherently, but the color usage panel renders hundreds of simultaneous hues with no perceptual grouping, making it a dense lookup surface rather than a readable pattern — and animation/filter propagation across all four views cannot be assessed from a static screenshot.
